name: Report of Suspected Fraud
description: Anyone who suspects fraud, financial impropriety, or irregularity must report it right away.
recipient: Superintendent or designee (or Board President / District Solicitor if the Superintendent is involved)
quote: Board members, District employees, volunteers, consultants, vendors, or contractors who suspects fraud, impropriety, or irregularity shall immediately report their suspicions to the Superintendent or designee, or if the event that the suspicions involve the Superintendent, to the Board President or District Solicitor.
